description: Ask an AI-powered question about your media using Speak AI's AI Chat. Supports querying a single file, multiple files, entire folders, or your whole workspace. Pass mediaIds for specific files, folderIds for entire folders, or omit both to search across all media. Use assistantType to get specialized responses (e.g., 'researcher' for academic analysis, 'sales' for deal insights). To continue a conversation, pass the promptId from a previous response. Returns a promptId — save it to continue the conversation with follow-up questions. Set analysisMediaId + analysisInput to have the model listen to the audio or watch the video instead of reading the transcript alone. That is a premium feature and costs credits per hour of media — call get_analysis_quote first to check eligibility and price.

analysisInput.description: 'audio' lets the model hear tone, pacing and delivery; 'video' also lets it see what is on screen. Omit for transcript-only, which is the default and costs nothing extra. 'transcript' is not a valid value here — omitting the field IS transcript-only.

analysisMediaId.description: Media to analyse as audio/video rather than transcript. Must also appear in mediaIds, and must be sent together with analysisInput. Premium feature.

assistantTemplateId.description: Required when assistantType is 'custom'. ID of a custom assistant template from list_prompts.

endDate.description: End date for date range filter (ISO 8601, e.g., '2025-03-31')

fieldId.description: Scope the prompt to a single custom field

fieldIds.description: Scope the prompt to multiple custom fields (max 10)

filters.description: Advanced filter object to scope which media the prompt runs over

folderId.description: Single folder ID to scope the query to. Use folderIds for multiple folders.

folderIds.description: Array of folder IDs to scope the query to. Omit along with mediaIds to search across all media.

isIndividualPrompt.description: When true, processes each media file separately instead of combining context. Useful for comparing responses across files.

mediaIds.description: Array of media IDs to query. Omit along with folderIds to search across all media in your workspace.

prompt.description: The question or prompt to ask about the media

promptId.description: ID of an existing conversation to continue. Pass this to maintain chat context across multiple questions.

speakers.description: Filter to specific speaker IDs from the transcript

startDate.description: Start date for date range filter (ISO 8601, e.g., '2025-01-01')

name: ask_ai_chat

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
